Imagine our entire digital history lasting millennia. Discover how femtosecond lasers are etching petabytes of data into indestructible fused quartz glass, preserving humanity's knowledge for 10,000 years. This isn't sci-fi, it's our future!

cuts.voiceoverText: What if your digital photos, our entire internet, could last 10,000 years?
Current data storage degrades fast; hard drives fail, leaving huge gaps in our history.
But femtosecond lasers are now etching petabytes of data into indestructible fused quartz glass.
Each tiny glass plate holds over 360 terabytes, resisting heat, water, and time.
Imagine libraries of human knowledge preserved, accessible for the next ten millennia.
This isn't sci-fi; it's our future, leaving everyone still asking...
